trap.label: discuss/examine (relatório)
trap.wrong: The authors advertise that it is risky.
trap.right: The authors warn that it is risky.
trap.why: Advertise é falso cognato de advertir. Advertir = warn. Em textos acadêmicos, ainda, o brasileiro costuma acrescentar preposição desnecessária.

fix.wrong: The authors advertise us not to go.
fix.right: The authors warn us not to go.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Researchers find that it works.”
Reescreva sem preposição: “The study examined about sleep.”
Use warn: “The authors say: don’t trust it.” (us)
rewrite.answer: The authors warn us not to trust it.
